svg.title: ENTX system map
svg.desc: TMDB data seeds a catalogue at build time. The browser runs the market simulation (AMM, EPI, news-driven prices) and persists to localStorage. Users sign Solana memo receipts and NEAR transactions directly; the server oracle signs report_epi with a restricted key; the Intents route fetches dry-run quotes.
svg.text: simulated in the browser · verified on chain
Dashed purple: the Solana signature rides into NEAR as chain_ref, linking one trade across both chains.
runs on the server, never in the browser
